title: Entity tick under mobcap saturation
description: A large, stable population of hostile and passive mobs ticking within simulation distance. The primary scenario for mob-optimisation mods: entity ticking, mob AI goal selection, collision, and despawn checks. Run under tick warp so the cost is measurable even when the server would otherwise sit comfortably at 20 TPS — below budget, TPS reports 20 for every configuration and reveals nothing.

setup.comment: Deterministic placement on a fixed lattice. Natural spawning would vary the population between runs and destroy comparability — this is why doMobSpawning is off.
Let AI goals settle before warmup begins.

workload.comment: Mob AI is itself the load; the workload only needs to let ticks proceed.
